title: Compatible exact tensor and pullback shift structures
statement: Let f:Z → Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use the ambient derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], their shared K-flat derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and F=Lf* [def-pc-derived-pullback], with the supplied strong monoidal structure. There exist coherent integer-shift structures on F and on every tensorRight M on both categories, such that F and all these tensor functors are triangulated. The tensor shifts on Z are natural in the fixed factor: for every b:M → N, the natural transformation K ↦ K tensor b commutes with shifts. For every M in D(O_Y), the flipped inverse tensorator F(K tensor M) → F(K) tensor F(M), natural in K, commutes with the composite shifts. No independently fixed pullback shift, direct image, adjunction, counit, projection mate, or projection invertibility is assumed or concluded.

source.place: Tag 08EU, proof: exactness of the two composite functors; Cohomology, equation (20.54.2.1)

proof.text: On K-flat representatives, use the Koszul shift comparison for total tensor in its first variable. The comparison is natural in the fixed second variable. Tensor of mapping cones is the corresponding mapping cone, so the resulting tensor functors are triangulated. Termwise tensor pullback on K-flat resolutions likewise preserves mapping cones and commutes with translation.

Choose the pullback comparison together with the tensor comparisons for the supplied strong monoidal structure, rather than fixing a shift of pullback in advance. Express translation as tensor with the translated unit and transport through the inverse tensorator and the unit isomorphism. Tensorator associativity gives the addition identity and its unit identities give the zero identity. Transport the distinguished cone triangles along the comparison isomorphisms. The resulting exact pullback and tensor shift structures make the flipped inverse tensorator commute with translation in its varying first factor.

Descend these natural comparisons through K-flat localization; the comparisons respect quasi-isomorphisms and the zero and addition equations descend as equalities. Naturality of the tensor comparison in its fixed second variable gives NatTrans.CommShift for every tensorRight morphism. These are precisely the two compatibility clauses of the theorem. The zero object, empty schemes, and zero shifts are included by the unit/zero equations.

proof_origin.place: Exactness assertion in Tag 08EU proof, expanded using the K-flat tensor/pullback constructions and monoidal transport from steps 2–3 of lem-sc-projection-comparison-exact; equation (20.54.2.1) fixes the inverse tensorator orientation.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedPullback_tensorShift
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)] :
    ∃ (sF : (derivedPullback f).CommShift ℤ)
      (sY : ∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Y, (tensorRight M).CommShift ℤ)
      (sZ : ∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Z, (tensorRight M).CommShift ℤ),
      letI := sF
      letI := sY
      letI := sZ
      (derivedPullback f).IsTriangulated ∧
      (∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Y, (tensorRight M).IsTriangulated) ∧
      (∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Z, (tensorRight M).IsTriangulated) ∧
      (∀ {M N : schemeDerivedCategory Z} (b : M ⟶ N),
        NatTrans.CommShift ((curriedTensor (schemeDerivedCategory Z)).flip.map b) ℤ) ∧
      (∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Y,
        NatTrans.CommShift
          (F₁ := tensorRight M ⋙ derivedPullback f)
          (F₂ := derivedPullback f ⋙ tensorRight ((derivedPullback f).obj M))
          ((Functor.flipping.functor.map
            (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δNatTrans (derivedPullback f))).app M) ℤ)
